purpose: Activate true browser anti-framing enforcement on a future hosting/proxy configuration that supports response headers.
integration: Send these as actual HTTP response headers. Preserve the existing restrictive page CSP; multiple CSP policies are intersected. Do not replace the full application policy with a broad allow policy.
currentMitigation: Early top-level window guard plus default-hidden HTML and runtime deny-all CSP in frames. Native top-level WebView remains supported.
remainingLimitation: GitHub Pages response headers were not configured. Client-side mitigation does not replace HTTP frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options and the header finding is not fully closed.
